about: Web packshots for catalog.json products. Each image was downloaded once, background-cleaned, fitted within 360x360 on a white 400x400 canvas and saved as WebP. sourcePage is where the product was matched; imageUrl is the original image. confidence: exact = brand, variant and size match; close = same product but size/pack/label variant may differ; uncertain = best available match, name differs.
